summary: Agricola: Family Edition strips out the occupation and minor improvement cards and softens the food penalties, turning the original's punishing engine puzzle into a gentler, faster farm-building race for newcomers and families. It keeps the worker-placement bones but removes most of the swinginess.
praised: accessible on-ramp to Agricola's farm-building core
faster, less punishing than the full game
good teaching tool before moving to the full version
criticised: loses the card-driven variety that gives the original its replay value
feels thin for experienced euro gamers
still has worker-placement blocking that can frustrate younger players

interaction.detail: Players build up their own individual farms, with the only interaction coming from a shared board of action spaces where placing a worker occupies that space for the round and blocks others from using it. There is no common market, direct conflict, or negotiation beyond this competition for limited actions.

scoring.how_you_win: Grow and develop your farm (fields, animals, house, family) without leaving spaces empty or going hungry; highest sum of farm categories after 14 rounds wins.
